name: MediPhi-Instruct
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from microsoft/Phi-3.5-mini-instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A merge of microsoft/Phi-3.5-mini-instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 3.821 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-07-11. Caveats: CLUE+ is the vendor's own extension of CLUE (12 tasks, avg row). Every row is the vendor's own benchmark and the base is Phi-3.5-mini-instruct, whose 36.5 average is the same table's first column. Two CLUE+ rows regress (PLS 28.4 -> 26.0, MeDiSumCode 41.1 -> 37.2, ACI 42.3 -> 43.5 is a gain) - only the wins are recorded. Medical/clinical domain; not a general-purpose gain.
